result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_dag()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if directed graph is a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5582-L5628){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_dag() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Is DAG](/assets/graphs/is-dag.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: a directed graph on five nodes where every edge leads rightward or downward, so no path returns to its start and is_dag() returns True. Right: the same graph with the edge between B and C reversed, which creates the cycle B, E, C, B (shown in the accent color), so is_dag() returns False." width="100%"} A DAG is a directed graph with no cycles. You cannot follow directed edges and return to a starting node. DAGs are fundamental for dependency resolution, scheduling, and topological sorting. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if the graph is acyclic, `False` if it contains cycles. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If called on an undirected graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#309d5c15 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) graph.is_dag() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Adding an edge back from "C" to "A" closes the loop `A -> B -> C -> A`, so the graph is no longer acyclic: ::: {#9b907cb0 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.add_edge("C", "A") graph.is_dag() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: :::
